COPY
FOR INFORMATION OF M.I.5

Home Office,
Aliens Department,
P.O. Box No.2,
Bournemouth,
Hampshire.

1st July, 1942.

L.4050/4.

Sir,

With reference to the case of Ernst LOEWENHEIM, R.C.585192, I am directed by the Secretary of State to inform you that this man may be registered as of uncertain nationality.

I am,
Sir,
Your obedient Servant,

(Signed) E.J. Smith.

The Commissioner of Police of the Metropolis.
